title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree
hints: The LCA is the deepest node whose subtree contains both p and q. What would each subtree have to report upward for its parent to decide?
Think post-order: ask the left and right subtrees first, then combine. A subtree that contains neither node reports None.

Return the node itself when it is p or q (a node is its own ancestor). If both the left and the right call return something, the current node is the answer; otherwise pass up whichever side is non-None.
